focus: Implement the shared LLM execution service end to end and validate it against real providers.

evidence_quality_notes: Strong: real-provider runs, real SIGKILL, live quota exhaustion, metric/trace reconciliation. Weakest area is judge-variance breadth (single-run stability shown; a larger repeated-judgment study is a Gen-2 item).
loc_context: Service + tests are compact and comment-dense by intent; each non-obvious guard cites the mission line or the failure it prevents. LOC is evidence, not a goal.
